newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP oil production down in Sept.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP oil production down in Sept.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday its oil/condensate production in the four months to September 30 was down two percent from the same period a year ago after a fall of seven percent in the month of September.

Higher contributions were reported from the North West Shelf offshore Western Australia and from new production at the Liverpool Bay project in the United Kingdom for the four month period. Gas production, including liquefied natural gas (LNG) sales, remained stable, with higher contribution from the U.K.
At Liverpool Bay, the replacement of the flare tip on the Douglas platform enabled oil production to increase from the Douglas field over the four-month period, BHP said.
Oil and condensate production totalled 23.23 million barrels in the four months, down up from 23.62 million a year earlier.
September production totalled 5.46 million barrels, down from 5.86 million in September 1995.
Gas production in the four months to September 30 were flat at 91.4 billion cubic feet. For the month, production was up one percent at 21.8 billion cubic feet.
